search_text: published ZDI-23-1033 ZDI-CAN-20615 Triangle MicroWorks SCADA Data Gateway Use of Hard-coded Cryptograhic Key Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2023-08-04 CVE-2023-39465 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-39465 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['Triangle MicroWorks'] ['SCADA Data Gateway'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Triangle MicroWorks SCADA Data Gateway. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the TmwCrypto class. The issue results from the usage of a hard-coded cryptograhic key and the usage of a hard-coded certificate. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose sensitive information. Triangle MicroWorks has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
